text:
Ava: Morning check — queue sitting at 42 (up ~12 from last handoff). Top buckets: embeddings errors 18, auth 10, billing 7, misc 7. Known issue: embed generation timeouts in eu-west affecting ~30% of embed requests; SRE is tracking. Using macro `embed-followup` for affected customers. Today I'm clearing the oldest 15 embeds and doing PR review for #512. Blocker: need an EU-friendly macro wording — can someone update? :coffee:

Diego: I can update the macro in a few mins. Will add an explicit ETA note for EU customers and a small apology line.

Priya: I can pick up the auth ones, please reassign to me. I'll also scan for any regressions tied to the latest auth rollout.

Sam: Taking billing queue. Noted the spike might be linked to the billing webhook retries we saw yesterday. I'll coordinate with finance.

triage-bot: Alert: 1728801200 Incident logged — embed-timeout-eu. Assigned: eng-sre. Severity: medium.

Diego: Macro draft (please copy into macros library and tag with alias `embed-eu`):

```
Name: embed-eu
Message: Hi — we’re seeing embed generation delays in EU regions. Our SRE team is actively investigating; typical ETA ~15-30 mins. If you need immediate help, reply and we’ll prioritize your request. Apologies for the interruption.
Tags: embed, eu, outage
```

Ava: Nice. Two quick asks: (1) add a short bullet about workarounds (switch to smaller model/region) and (2) add an internal note line so ops know to escalate customers on high-SLA plans.

Diego: Added both. Macro now in library as `embed-eu` and aliased to `embed-followup`. I also included: "If you’re on Dedicated/Private, open a support VPN ticket and we’ll prioritize."

Priya: Reassign command I used: `/assign ticket 4572 @Priya` and `/label add 4572 auth-issue`. Quick tip: use quick filters `is:embed region:eu` to surface the ones to prioritize.

Sam: Pinged finance about webhook retry queue. Also leaving a short billing macro update (copy below):

```
Name: billing-retry
Message: Hi — we’re investigating duplicate charge reports. If you've been double-charged, please DM us your invoice id and we'll escalate to finance. We're pausing automatic retries for now.
```

Ava: Thanks all. Action list: Diego — confirm macro tested and mark resolved in ops doc; Priya — take auth tickets and message if you see escalation patterns; Sam — follow up with finance on retries; I'll clear oldest 15 embed tickets and finish PR review.

Diego: Macro tested in staging channel, looks good. Left a note in #ops-docs. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Reassigned 6 auth tickets to myself, flagged 2 for escalation. Will update if I find a rollback cause.

Sam: Finance acknowledged, they will manually reconcile any duplicates for impacted customers.

Ava: Last thing — quick CR ping: @Sam can you glance at #512? small serialization bug in ticket export. If you can approve or leave comments by EOD that helps.

Sam: On it, will try to review in the next hour.

triage-bot: Reminder scheduled: nightly summary will run at 23:00 UTC. Will include counts and macro usage stats.

Ava: Great. If anything major crops up, call it out here and we’ll do a quick Huddle. Otherwise I’ll post end-of-shift summary in ~6 hours. :wave:
